meta.title: DAY 1 #3 — The shrew's fiddle
meta.source: User script (verbatim). Shrew's fiddle / Halsgeige ('neck violin'): wooden neck-and-wrist restraint used in Germany & Austria to punish women for bickering; a double version held two people face to face (Wikipedia citing Rublack, The Crimes of Women in Early Modern Germany; Britannica).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the middle ages, the “shrew's fiddle” was used to punish women who were caught bickering.

scenes.name: Double fiddle

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The “double fiddle” attached two people together face-to-face, forcing them to talk to each other.

scenes.note: A two-person version held them face to face

scenes.name: Resolved

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They were not released until the argument had been resolved.

scenes.note: “Released when resolved” — told in secondary sources
